targeting.metaDescription: Fix n8n's item-linking error with tested pairedItem and itemMatching examples. Avoid first() fixes that quietly select the wrong customer or order.
targeting.excerpt: Fix n8n's "Can't determine which item to use" error without selecting the wrong customer. Follow tested examples for pairedItem, filtering, itemMatching, splits and aggregation, plus documented Merge guidance.

targeting.summary: Distinguish missing pairing, multiple ancestors and unexecuted nodes before changing an expression|Preserve input indexes before filtering or sorting and use itemMatching for the current Code input|Verify customer identities before reconnecting messages or writes; first() can succeed with the wrong record
